title: Mixed Event — Let SEKAI Hear Your Song! — Episode3 A Voice Breaks Through

meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGERS of each SEKAI see how everyone is progressing toward their goals. They are excitedly preparing ways to demonstrate their support for everyone, when something extraordinary happens.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, Rin, you both looked really cute during that dance routine! Len, you exuded a princely aura! Lastly, MEIKO, Luka, I was blown away by your singing performance!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You all shined so much that I don't think we'll need to use any lights!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I appreciate the praise, but I feel a little embarrassed now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Minori and the others aren't gonna know what to do with themselves!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, I doubt they will.
Still...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We can't be satisfied with just this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, I think you can look even cuter and act yourself more during your solo when you're dancing on center stage.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin, Len, you two could jump out in front and interact with the audience more. MEIKO, we need to synchronize our movements better.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Finally, KAITO, you should join us for this next one! It just doesn't feel the same if all six of us aren't involved.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes...
It would be nice to spread hope with all of you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, give me a minute to get ready...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In the meantime, why don't we go through that dance routine again?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, let's really get it down!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I don't normally say things like what I just did...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(But I couldn't help myself...
I really want to show Minori and the others that we're there for them.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (We all feel the same way about that, don't we...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Of course we do. They're wonderful girls who always do their best for the sake of others...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (We all want them to keep advancing towards their goal.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which means I need to keep doing my best to support them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
“I'm gonna try, master!
I'm gonna use this energy to make everyone smile...!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad Emu and the others are gonna get to keep pursuing their dreams together...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Don't ever let their smiles fade away...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nice practice, everyone!!
You all did a wonderful job!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah! Especially you, Miku!
You really gave it your all there!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I started tearing up during the final scene☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're going a little overboard, Miku!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's quite impressive that you cry every time we practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All these emotions well up inside of me when I think about the others! I can't stop myself from crying!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, I know I need to keep it together when we do this for real! Because I'm gonna cast a spell on all of them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I, uhh... I thought I heard someone's voice just now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I feel like we're being watched...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
By who?
Tsukasa and the others aren't supposed to be here yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Maybe it was just my imagination...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we do another run-through before they get here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
And let's get the lights all set up like we're doing this for real!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, good idea! Let's do that!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think... They heard you, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa! That's amazing!
How'd you do that?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I-I'm not sure...
They were all doing their best, so I just...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I understand how you feel, Miku. I also wish I could show my support for everyone in each SEKAI sometimes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me too...
If only there were a way for us to do that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Did something flash just now...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. It looks like a ball of light.
